fieldEvidence.excerpt: Aethera Technologies is a Halifax radio-frequency engineering company developing solid-state RF power systems, custom electronics, software and engineering services for space propulsion, fusion energy, wireless communications and industrial processing.
Aethera Technologies has a documented Canadian operating presence in Halifax, Nova Scotia.

Aethera develops solid-state RF generators and power-processing electronics that can be adapted for high-power industrial processes and electric space-propulsion systems, including vacuum-qualified work associated with VASIMR.
Solid-state RF power generation; Custom RF hardware and software; Power-processing electronics; Vacuum and space-propulsion adaptation

A Canadian Space Agency profile documents a $1.5 million contribution and successful testing of Aethera power-processing technology for Ad Astra's VASIMR system, while Aethera's current official site continues to present RF products and engineering activity from Halifax.
The Canadian Space Agency documents a $1.5 million contribution that supported Aethera's adaptation and testing of RF power-processing technology for the VASIMR electric-propulsion system.
Space-qualified RF power electronics could enable satellite systems used for northern sensing and communications; this is a derived enabling-technology assessment, not a documented Arctic deployment.
